feature.name: Tables
feature.what_it_does: Insert tables to organize content in rows and columns; a selected table brings up its own Table Design and Table Layout contextual tabs.
feature.behavior: Insert tables to organize content in rows and columns; a selected table brings up its own Table Design and Table Layout contextual tabs. Group controls: subfeature:table-insert

connections.why: table cells contain paragraphs formatted by the Paragraph tools

subfeatures.name: Table
subfeatures.what_it_does: Opens the table builder: a hover grid to insert an N×M table instantly, plus Insert Table…, Draw Table, Convert Text to Table…, Excel Spreadsheet and Quick Tables. A selected table activates the Table Design + Table Layout contextual tabs (measured).
subfeatures.behavior: Opens Table (dropdown). Contents (5 controls): Draw Table, Excel Spreadsheet, Quick Tables, Insert Table..., Convert Text to Table.... Sub-surfaces: ui:table-insert-dropdown-quick-tables, ui:table-insert-dropdown-insert-table. [flyout of subfeature:table-insert — commands/tiles are endpoints; openers descended per the depth-endpoint rule; sections: Insert Table] Appears as a 4x4 grid labelled 'Table' with a dropdown chevron.

connections.why: Sort operates on table contents as well as paragraphs
